title: Call for Proposals: Caste, Corporeality, and Performance (GPS: Global Performance Studies Special Issue)
description: GPS: Global Performance Studies, a peer-reviewed Open Access journal, has issued a call for proposals for a special issue on 'Caste, Corporeality, and Performance,' edited by Anusha Kedhar (University of California Riverside) and Brahma Prakash (Jawaharlal Nehru University). Proposals are due 20 September 2026, followed by a multi-stage drafting process (first drafts 15 December 2026, second drafts 1 March 2027, final drafts 15 August 2027), with publication expected around September 2027. Submissions may take the form of a conventional 6,000-9,000 word text in English, or performance recordings, creative writing, photography, or interviews. No article processing charge or fee is mentioned on the page.
